title: signal-convergence-and-alert-policy-heuristics
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem: Operational teams are seeing noisy alerts for transient tail latency and short-lived error spikes across inference routes. Current SLO tooling treats signals independently which leads to duplicate pages and high cognitive load for oncall. Goal: converge tracing hooks, metric/log rollups, and anomaly scoring into a single 'signal convergence' pipeline that produces deduplicated SLO events and an adaptive alert policy engine. Key outcomes: reduce duplicate pages by >=60%, surface root-cause spans with the SLO event, and enable 'error-velocity' alerts (a short-window escalation for rapid regressions) alongside time-window SLO burn detection.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Tracing hooks emit route/model tags in 95% of inference spans; 2) Metrics pipeline produces per-route latency histograms and error-rate counters with 30s ingestion latency; 3) Alert engine deduplicates correlated signals and reduces duplicate pages by >=60% in canary; 4) Error-velocity alert triggers correctly in synthetic regression test; 5) No >5% increase in p50/p95 latency due to additional instrumentation.
implementation_plan: Phase A - Instrumentation (2w): add lightweight trace hooks in serving runtime to attach route_id, model_version, shard_id, and request_path; expose sampling controls via env flag. Phase B - Pipeline (2w): update metrics collector config to build per-route histograms, convert error logs to structured events with trace_id linking. Phase C - Scoring & Alerting (2w): implement signal convergence microservice that ingests traces/metrics/logs, computes anomaly score and error-velocity, produces canonical SLO events and a deduplication key for paging. Phase D - Canary & Rollout (1w): run on 10% of traffic for two services, monitor false positive/negative rates, iterate on thresholds. Phase E - Docs & Runbook (1w): publish runbook, SLO dashboard widgets, and oncall playbook.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: runtime instrumentation adds CPU overhead. Mitigation: sampling default 1% for full-span annotation, ability to enable full tracing per-route for canary. Risk: deduplication hides distinct issues. Mitigation: retain raw signal store for 7 days and include 'alternate-cause' tags when deduplication heuristics are uncertain. Risk: metric backpressure on ingestion. Mitigation: use histogram downsampling and backfill on retention-critical routes.
notes: This ticket synthesizes prior SLO work (see ENG-7043 and ENG-27643) but focuses on merging signals and rethinking paging heuristics rather than only burn-rate tuning. We will refer to the Console SLO schema and coordinate with Platform Security for any trace sampling that includes sensitive identifiers.
